Callout.Name: Drone Over Houses
Callout.Advisory: Operator seen on a nearby roof, no offence reported.

Script.Line: It is my drone. I am filming the sunset.
It is over my own garden. Look at the screen, it is my garden.
I will bring it down. It is coming down now.

Lines.Approach: Low over the gardens, and the operator is up on a roof. Somebody has complained about that specific drone three times.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
